changelog:
• Fixed Auto-Detect results not being applied correctly (especially MASQUE)
• Auto-Detect: manual protocol list replaced with ranked test results you can tap to apply
• Speed Test: fixed UI freeze on start, inaccurate upload speed, wrong jitter and lost results
• Speed Test: parallel download streams, live quality verdict, custom server and test history
• MTU input and Optimize button are now perfectly aligned in settings
• Various bug fixes and user interface improvements
• HEV tunnel engine updated to v2.17.1
• HEV now connects directly to the core for better stability
• Fixed VPN data path: sessions and DNS now work reliably in TUN mode
• Connecting state now shows instantly on the dashboard
• Fixed cold-start lag: heavy tasks moved off the main thread
• Logs screen: filter by source (App / Aether Core) and level
• Fixed Zero Trust settings reopening after protocol change
